brief.text:
Design brief (Frans, 17 Nov)

Look: A (Folded paper) and C (Postcards) look best. B is the most informative but ugly. D is too hard to use.
Next: one direction that pairs A/C's look with B's scannable fare info.
Hero: today's best deal, the rest below.
Devices: phone and laptop get equal care.
Version 1 features: region and price filters, a 30-day price chart per route, a watchlist of starred destinations.
Later: stub budget link.

heading.text: Paper Plane: four directions for the home screen
